fusions.name: Host to Host
fusions.desc: Sends a flea at the first enemy in a line up to 6 tiles away that deals 7 damage, then hops on to 3 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the first. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Linked Infestation
fusions.desc: A burst of bites that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, and your afflictions on each of them spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Shortened Tether
fusions.desc: Lays a line of links 6 tiles long for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies toward it and slows those it catches by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Jump Ship
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 8 lightning damage, then on to 2 more within 3 tiles at 60%. Once every 6 seconds.
